title: Otis Project Management
summary: This note details the owner's role as a project manager at Otis, managing a large portfolio of construction elevator projects. The role involved coordinating stakeholders, managing risk at scale, and solving technical problems while holding full P&L responsibility.

key_points.text: Managing a $47M portfolio of 50+ new construction elevator projects simultaneously
Stakeholder coordination: Aligning multiple internal and external parties - contractors, architects, city officials, building owners
Risk management at scale: Monitoring for early warning signs, flagging problems before they escalated, and coordinating rapid responses
Technical problem-solving: Handling design modifications, code compliance issues, construction conflicts, and getting team buy off
Full P&L responsibility for the portfolio and accountability for hitting financial metrics across all projects
